checklistSources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

facts: No online trophies, no glitched trophies

1 potentially missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude — and the guides disagree: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer and OutputLag flag it as possibly missable, Push Square lists no known missables; nothing is confirmed either way
15 manual save slots + 1 autosave; no mission replay
Free-roam after the story — nothing else is missable
missableNote: Possibly missable, not confirmed: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it. Flagged possibly missable by PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer and OutputLag; Push Square lists no known missables. Do the balcony meditation to be safe — it takes a minute and removes the risk.

bullets: Do optional missions as they appear — any 100 are needed for the checklist
Scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you go
CHAPTER 1: do Lucia's balcony meditation after Down to Earth — the only possibly missable trophy
Work the character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Cal, Bret) as they unlock
Don't use cheats — they disable trophies and saving
stages.text: Five chapters, 60–80 hours. All 12 story trophies pop automatically. Do the side content as it appears — the 100% checklist counts progress made during the story.
stages.title: Play the story

bullets: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges; win all 42 drone races
Rob 5 bank vaults, all 8 bank jobs and all 39 gang operations
Scan 200 vehicles, study 100 animals, WAiNK 100 locations, 15 of 18 meditations
Finish any 70 of the 80 challenges — skip the hardest 10
Register 10 vehicles, buy all 8 garages, launder $250,000 in marked bills
stages.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list down. The checklist is lenient — about 60% true completion.
stages.title: 100% completion + cleanup

bullets: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count
Do the UFO easter egg (The Truth Is Out There) and the two one-offs (Ocean View Bar, showroom Banshee)
Check the two unverified trophies — Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin — against the latest community findings
stages.text: The final sweep: the stranger strands, the easter eggs and the two trophies the community has not cracked yet.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks + the last two

title: Road to the platinum
